name: Call of Duty API
description:
Unofficial Call of Duty API for accessing player stats, match history, and account information.

## Authentication
This API requires authentication using the ACT_SSO_COOKIE cookie obtained from callofduty.com.

## Game Title Codes
- mw2 - Modern Warfare 2 (2022)
- mw - Modern Warfare (2019)
- bo4 - Black Ops 4
- cw - Black Ops Cold War
- vg - Vanguards
- bo3 - Black Ops 3
- iw - Infinite Warfare
- ww2 - World War 2
- jup - Modern Warfare 3 (2023)
- cer - Black Ops 6
- bo7 - Black Ops 7

## Platform Codes
- battle - Battle.net
- bnet - Battle.net (alternative)
- uno - Activision/UNO
- xbl - Xbox Live
- psn - PlayStation Network
- steam - Steam

## Mode Codes
- mp - Multiplayer
- wz - Warzone
- zm - Zombies
